metrics.interpretation: Differences are coupled minus control on identical queries. Positive margin favors the best exact-optimal action.

step_index_meaning: Saved step index0 is the first action; a saved median1 means the second action.
interpretation: Three fixed30k phases, one shared initial checkpoint, identical validation queries/horizon/candidate order/greedy rule and predeclared checkpoint selection. Control versus shuffled tests the full local-path data recipe; shuffled versus joint holds relation multisets per250 batches fixed and tests same-batch co-occurrence under the unchanged separable losses. No Bellman loss. First nonoptimal can be a recoverable detour; first dead entry is separate. Compare initial margins on identical states. Bootstrap intervals are conditional on one training seed.

optimization_diagnostics.training_loss_logging: Each progress loss is a single current batch, not a moving average or fixed training probe. Convergence is unestablished.
limitations: No fixed seen-training-relation probe across saved checkpoints yet.
Large absolute error alone does not identify insufficient updates, optimization instability, generalization failure or representation limits.
Last checkpoints have not received matched complete greedy validation; selected checkpoint results cannot establish the rollout trend.
